title: Money
description: What the work costs: what is paid regularly (hosting, a subscription, a licence), beside what agents spent, which the kernel measures from their runs.

types.title: Cost
types.description: Something paid for regularly: hosting, a subscription, a licence, a domain. What agents spend per token is not kept here: it is measured from their runs.

amount.description: What is paid each time, in the currency below. Left out when nobody has said: it is then shown as not priced.

since.description: The first day it was paid for. Left out: the day it was written down.

until.description: The last day it is paid for, when that is known.

url.description: Where the bill or the plan can be looked at.

views.description: What the work costs: what agents spent over the last days (dollars where a run says what it cost, tokens where it does not, by where they ran), each regular payment (a cost item: hosting, a subscription) with its share of the period, the total, and the rate per month. Nothing is guessed: a payment with no amount is named as not priced. Params: days (default 30).

days.description: The period, in days back from today: 30 unless given.

full.description: true for the answer whole, as the screen has it.
